title: Twice the text, four times the pairs

knows: Small arithmetic and the prerequisites listed below.
doesNotKnow: dense all-pairs attention has a token-pair score count growing quadratically with sequence length; not every transformer cost, latency or memory allocation equals that count.

claims.text: The retained full matrices contain 16 and 64 ordered pairs. Doubling both dimensions multiplies this count by four. A causal mask permits only 10 and 36 of those pairs here. Pair counts are not measurements of wall-clock time, energy, total model compute or mandatory memory allocation.

claims.text: Full attention has 6 queries and 6 keys, then 12 of each. What are the pair counts? Full ordered pairs are queries times keys: 6 times 6, then 12 times 12.
